topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: I stood there, looking over the rain-soaked fence at the neighbor’s place, the ground still soft from the night’s downpour. His eyes met mine, earnest and hopeful, the kind that’d make a saint lie. He asked if he could use a corner of my yard for a garden, something to grow, something to tend. I nodded, mouth dry, the words coming out tired. “Sure, I guess,” I mumbled, already seeing the mess, the intrusion, the things I couldn’t control. But there was a part of me, a small, quiet part, that didn’t mind the company, that almost wanted the bugger to succeed. Almost.
